label: Town of Woodford
header:
# Town of Woodford municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 28; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 175 (Town of Woodford): sec. 8(a) elects a three-member selectboard for staggered three-year terms
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Ryan Thurber, Wayne Tifft, and Steven Wright for Woodford

Town of Woodford, 2024 Annual Report, office-holders table (p. 4): Selectboard Ryan Thurber (to 2027), Wayne Tifft (to 2026), and Steven Wright (to 2025). The June 2026 Secretary of State directory still seats all three, so Wright is carried on incumbent-continuity (disclosed)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 175 (Town of Woodford): sec. 8(a) elects a town clerk for a three-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Susan Wright as Woodford's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Susan Wright as Woodford's Town Clerk (June 2026)

Town of Woodford, 2024 Annual Report, office-holders table (p. 4): Town Clerk Susan Wright (printed term to 2025); the January 2026 Guide and the June 2026 spreadsheet still name her, so she is carried on incumbent-continuity (disclosed)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 175 (Town of Woodford): sec. 8(a) elects a town treasurer for a three-year term; the treasurer is ex officio collector of current taxes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Gail Rutkowski as Woodford's Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Gail Rutkowski as Woodford's Town Treasurer (June 2026)

Town of Woodford, 2024 Annual Report, office-holders table (p. 4): Town Treasurer Gail Rutkowski (printed term to 2025); the January 2026 Guide and the June 2026 spreadsheet still name her, so she is carried on incumbent-continuity (disclosed)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 175 (Town of Woodford): sec. 8(a) elects a moderator from the floor for a one-year term

Town of Woodford, 2024 Annual Report, office-holders table (p. 4): Moderator Richard Frantz (printed term to 2025). No later outcome is published, so no holder is minted; Frantz is carried as a straggler on issue #163

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of Woodford Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 175 (Town of Woodford): sec. 8(a) elects a collector of delinquent taxes for a three-year term

Town of Woodford, 2024 Annual Report, office-holders table (p. 4): Collector of Delinquent Taxes James Kinney (printed term to 2026). No current roster names the holder, so no holder is minted; Kinney is carried as a straggler on issue #163
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 175 (Town of Woodford): sec. 8(a) elects three auditors for staggered three-year terms

Town of Woodford, 2024 Annual Report, office-holders table (p. 4): the report names only Auditor Virginia Ulitsch (printed term to 2025) and prints the other two seats vacant. No later outcome is published, so no holder is minted; Ulitsch is carried as a straggler on issue #163
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 175 (Town of Woodford): sec. 11(a)(8): cemetery commissioners are appointed

Town of Woodford, 2024 Annual Report, office-holders table (p. 4): the appointed officials table lists Cemetery Commissioners Maureen O'Neil, Linda Dovitski, and Virginia Ulitsch on indefinite terms (2024 vintage, disclosed)

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of Woodford Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists four Woodford justices of the peace: Virginia Ulitsch, Nancy Coleman, Maureen O'Neil, and Geraldine Leahy
Town of Woodford, 2024 Annual Report, office-holders table (p. 4): the report's justices line concurs with the certified slate

jp_election.name: Town of Woodford Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the November 5, 2024 election of four justices of the peace for Woodford: Virginia Ulitsch, Nancy Coleman, Maureen O'Neil, and Geraldine Leahy. NOTE: Woodford's listers were eliminated by voter approval on March 1, 2022 and replaced by an outside assessing firm (2024 Annual Report), so no lister post is created even though ch. 175 sec. 8(a) still prints the office -- flagged on issue #163
